source_artifact.content_excerpt: Orchestrate clean closes tabs and removes worktrees but never retires the herdr workspace that held them, and it offers no way to release a unit worktree at merge time so the branch can be deleted. Both were observed on the issue 847 run: seven empty lane workspaces survived closeout and had to be retired by hand, and gh pr merge --delete-branch failed three separate times because a worktree still held the branch.
